:tor: Tor Guard Relay v2.2.0 is out! 🧅🐋

A server is replaceable. Recovering the same relay identity needs a plan.

This update focuses on clearer diagnostics, safer updates and encrypted recovery, so running a relay means more than watching a container stay green.

What's new:
🛡️ Tor 0.4.9.14 or newer required in both variants
🩺 Current-run health, readiness and doctor diagnostics
🔐 Verified encrypted backups and staged offline recovery
🛠️ Validated configuration changes and safer reloads
📦 AMD64 + ARM64 images published from the exact candidates that passed validation
🔄 Reviewed dependency updates and ongoing security audits

The write-up also covers the rebuild improvements, protected registry cleanup and real deployment screenshots.

⚠️ Upgrading? Read the upgrade guidance first. Legacy plaintext backup helpers are retired.

🔗 https://brokenbot.net/v2.2.0

Already running it? I'd love feedback on the diagnostics and backup workflow. Bug reports and suggestions are welcome 🐛💡

Protecting privacy, one relay at a time :tor: ✨

#Tor #Privacy #OpenSource #Docker #SelfHosting #Infosec
